phase.remaining: implementation, gate provenance and setup recipe portions remain deferred; individual statuses below preserve triage disposition

verification: source/test reading, public reference/feed fetches, Context7 CLI documentation; no installation/build/test/hardware execution by investigator

findings.claim: Factory XML lacks local borrowed/owned connection lifetime contract.
findings.evidence: Direct factory borrows; extension calls OwnConnection; base disposal closes only owned connections. Ownership tests distinguish the paths.
findings.disposition: Add concise factory-local ownership/disposal/options guidance and one-live-session constraint without exhaustive speculative exceptions.

findings.claim: Helper examples use removed scpKeyParams named factory argument.
findings.evidence: Current OATH factory takes SessionCreationOptions; actual OATH helper puts ScpKeyParameters into options.
findings.disposition: Update both examples to current options shape, preserving connection/session disposal. No test helper runtime changes.

findings.claim: Single-transport OATH accepts no preference override; surrounding selection prose uses retired parameter shape.
findings.evidence: OATH accepts options.PreferredConnectionType=SmartCard; other types fail. Direct creation asserts preference against supplied connection.
findings.disposition: Distinguish no alternative transport from no accepted setting. Correct options shape for OATH-related shared selection guidance; verify actual signatures before touching other applet examples.

findings.claim: Linked Linux page describes PC/SC installation.
findings.evidence: Destination covers HID udev/access only; OATH uses SmartCard/PCSC.
findings.disposition: State the accurate PC/SC prerequisite and remove the false promise about the HID guide. Defer distro-specific installation commands until supported platforms/packages are confirmed.

findings.claim: Textual-secret bytes universally use Utf8 suffix; SDK clears every sensitive allocation.
findings.evidence: OATH DeriveKey.password intentionally has no suffix, matching changelog. Adjacent cleanup statement is normative under Operation rules, but reads as a fulfilled guarantee despite tracked cleanup omissions.
findings.disposition: Make encoding requirement accurate without imposing obsolete OATH naming; state SDK-owned temporary cleanup as an engineering obligation, distinguishing caller-owned returned buffers. Do not waive tracked defects.

findings.claim: Unqualified API reference link points to legacy v1 docs.
findings.evidence: Live yesdk landing page targets .NET Standard2.0 and legacy namespace/session shape; current branch uses net10/v2 factories.
findings.disposition: Label legacy destination v1 and direct v2 readers to current module/source docs. Do not invent a published v2 endpoint.

findings.claim: Advertised command help can enter destructive reset path.
findings.evidence: Reset dispatch recognizes force only, not help. reset --help --force reaches reset without confirmation. Source path confirmed by coordinator; no hardware commands run.
findings.disposition: Recognize help before discovery/execution and prevent mutation. Defer runtime usage-string correction with command dispatch fix, keeping the false help advertisement an open release-documentation dependency.

findings.claim: Positional parser claims to skip flag values only when present but treats boolean flags as value-taking.
findings.evidence: Every dash-prefixed token consumes any following non-dash token. --touch NAME SECRET loses NAME.
findings.disposition: Distinguish option arity and define ordering; correct comment with parser, not by normalizing the defect.

findings.claim: OathTool as a whole has no Spectre.Console dependency and is pipe-safe.
findings.evidence: Helpers use Console but executed device selection uses Spectre. Operation reviewer confirmed helper behavior, not a whole-tool machine-output contract.
findings.disposition: Scope plain-text rationale to these helpers; do not claim a whole-tool guarantee. Preserve useful stdout/stderr explanations.

findings.claim: Ownership comments narrate upstream/this-branch transition and overgeneralize process-lifetime leaks.
findings.evidence: Borrow/own behavior is current contract and directly tested.
findings.disposition: Keep ownership rationale/regression intent in present tense, remove completed branch-relative history. Test behavior unchanged.

findings.claim: Initialization accepts absent required SELECT fields or indexes short version values.
findings.evidence: Default firmware/empty salt survive missing tags; empty SELECT can initialize with common hash-derived ID. Version indexes three bytes without length validation. YKOATH SELECT defines required metadata.
findings.disposition: Define/enforce required fields and lengths with deliberate malformed-response errors, preserving unknown extensions. No supported-default claim in docs.

findings.claim: OATH SDK's 5.6.3 SCP gate is presented as proven device minimum.
findings.evidence: OATH gates any SCP parameters at effective5.6.3; Core gates SCP03at5.3/SCP11at5.7.2. Vendor docs give generic5.3 SCP03 and do not establish OATH-specific5.6.3 provenance.
findings.disposition: Document actual SDK/effective-version gates and separate SCP11 condition. Do not lower gate, publish broader support, or infer deliberate vendor deviation. Remove unsupported NEO physical-firmware shorthand/comparison narration where unnecessary.
